units.source_text: 玉鬘既封尚侍，大家催她早日入宫就任。

en.t: After Tamakazura was appointed Naishi no Kami, everyone urged her to enter the palace and take up the post soon.

units.source_text: 但她想道：“此事如何是好？

en.t: But she thought, "What am I to do about this?

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣名义上是父亲，尚且心怀不良，不得不防；

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, is my father in name, yet even he harbors improper intentions, so I must be on guard;

units.source_text: 何况到了宫中，万一皇上看中了我，发生了瓜葛，

en.t: and if I go to court and the emperor should take a liking to me, and some entanglement arose,

units.source_text: 则秋好皇后与弘徽殿女御一定多方妒恨我，教我难做人了。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu and the Kokiden Consort would surely envy and resent me in every way, making life unbearable.

units.source_text: 加之我身世孤零，源氏太政大臣与内大臣和我相识未久，

en.t: Besides, I am alone in the world, and both Genji the Grand Minister and the Inner Minister have known me only a short time,

units.source_text: 不曾深切计虑我的事情，对我的爱尚浅。

en.t: so they have never deeply considered my affairs, and their affection for me is still shallow.

units.source_text: 因此入宫之后，一定有许多人骂我，说我的坏话，希望我做笑柄。

en.t: Therefore, after I enter the palace, many people will surely abuse me, speak ill of me, and hope to make me a laughingstock.

units.source_text: 那就会不断地发生倒霉的事情了。”

en.t: Then misfortunes would keep happening without end."

units.source_text: 她年龄渐长，已经不是无知无识的人了，

en.t: As she had grown older, she was no longer ignorant and unknowing,

units.source_text: 因此东思西想，心绪缭乱，独自悄悄地悲叹。

en.t: so she turned the matter over in every direction, her mind in turmoil, and quietly lamented alone.

units.source_text: 她又想：“倘不入宫，就住在这六条院里，亦无不可。

en.t: She thought again, "If I do not enter the palace, it would be all right to remain here at Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 然而太政大臣存心不正，甚是可厌。

en.t: Yet the Grand Minister's intentions are improper, and that is deeply hateful.

units.source_text: 我能否找个机会，脱离此境，以清清白白之身来消灭世人对我的谣诼呢？

en.t: Could I find some chance to escape this situation and, by keeping myself pure and blameless, put an end to the world's slander against me?

units.source_text: 生身父亲内大臣呢，深恐太政大臣心中不悦，

en.t: As for my true father, the Inner Minister, he deeply fears displeasing the Grand Minister,

units.source_text: 因而不敢强要把我收回去公然当作女儿看待。

en.t: and therefore does not dare insist on taking me back and openly treating me as his daughter.

units.source_text: 如此说来，我无论入宫或住在六条院，都不能避免讨厌的色情事件。

en.t: In that case, whether I enter the palace or stay at Rokujo-in, I cannot avoid hateful romantic scandals.

units.source_text: 结果自己懊恼无尽，而外人议论纷纷，此身何其不幸！”

en.t: In the end I will suffer endless anguish while outsiders chatter about me; how unfortunate this life of mine is!"

units.source_text: 原来自从向生身父亲说明实情之后，源氏对她的态度更加肆无忌惮了，

en.t: In fact, ever since she had explained the truth to her real father, Genji's conduct toward her had become even more unrestrained,

units.source_text: 因此玉鬘独自悄悄地悲叹。

en.t: and so Tamakazura quietly grieved by herself.

units.source_text: 她非但没有可与畅谈衷曲的人，连可与偶尔略谈心事的母亲也没有。

en.t: She had no one with whom she could freely confide her deepest feelings, and not even a mother to whom she might occasionally speak a little of her troubles.

units.source_text: 内大臣和太政大臣都是令人望而却步的显贵人物，

en.t: Both the Inner Minister and the Grand Minister were eminent figures who made others hesitate to approach them,

units.source_text: 无论何事，都不好这般那般地同他们商量。

en.t: so no matter what the matter was, she could not easily consult them about this or that.

units.source_text: 她独坐窗前，凝望凄凉的暮色，

en.t: She sat alone by the window, gazing at the desolate evening light,

units.source_text: 悲叹自己这异于常人的薄命之身，那样子十分可怜。

en.t: and lamented her ill-fated life, so unlike that of ordinary people; the sight of her was deeply pitiable.
